title: It Takes Two
description: It Takes Two is a co-op-only action-adventure platformer by Hazelight Studios. Two players control Cody and May, a couple transformed into dolls, and must cooperate through highly varied levels where new mechanics appear constantly. On Nintendo Switch it supports same-system co-op, local wireless, and online play, with Friend's Pass allowing a friend to join without owning the full game.

gameplayPillars.title: Co-op Mechanics
gameplayPillars.description: Every major challenge is built around two complementary player roles.

gameplayPillars.title: Constant Variety
gameplayPillars.description: Levels introduce new tools, movement systems, minigames, and puzzle concepts.

gameplayPillars.title: Shared Story
gameplayPillars.description: Gameplay and narrative focus on Cody and May learning to work together.

worldSummary: Cody and May are transformed into dolls and pushed through a surreal journey shaped by their home, memories, and relationship.

storyChapters.title: A Family in Crisis
storyChapters.body: Cody and May plan to separate, but their daughter Rose wishes they could stay together. The parents are magically transformed into small handmade dolls.

storyChapters.title: Forced to Cooperate
storyChapters.body: Guided by Dr. Hakim, Cody and May must work together through a series of surreal environments where each area gives them complementary abilities.

storyChapters.title: Rebuilding the Bond
storyChapters.body: Their adventure forces them to confront resentment, forgotten passions, and the reasons their relationship broke down as they try to return to their daughter.
